text: The Maharashtra Horticulture Development Corporation Act 1984 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 198825 Act Number: 25 Enactment Date: 1988-11-16 Act Year: 1988 Short Title: The Maharashtra Horticulture Development Corporation Act 1984 Long Title: An Act to make a special provision for securing the orderly establishment in horticultural production in the State of Maharashtra, and for storage, transport, processing and marketing of horticulture produce and to assist generally in the organisation thereof and for the purpose of establishing Maharashtra Horticulture Development Corporation and for incidental and supplemental purposes connected with the matters aforesaid.
